title: Artichoke Tapenade - David Lebovitz
ldIngredientsRaw: 8-10 (14 ounces, or 250g) canned artichokes (drained well and quartered)
ldInstructionsRaw: In the bowl of a food processor, pulse the garlic, olives, capers, artichoke hearts, lemon juice, and olive oil, and until almost smooth, but still chunky.
Taste, and add salt, chile powder, and additional lemon juice, if desired.
Serve with toasted slices of baguette or crackers.
htmlIngredientLines: 8-10 (14 ounces, or 250g) canned artichokes, drained well and quartered
